DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL)

The lab results showing a massive white blood cell count alongside low hemoglobin and platelets, combined with the specific presence of cells having "needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions" on the smear, are pathognomonic for APL. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment to prevent fatal bleeding.
